newsitem.title: USA: Timberland names Geoffrey Hibner as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Timberland names Geoffrey Hibner as CFO.

text.p: Timberland Co, a footwear and apparel maker, said Wednesday it appointed Geoffrey Hibner as senior vice president of finance and administration and chief financial officer.

Hibner was most recently principal financial officer for Frontier Technologies Corp, a closely-held Internet software development company, Timberland said. Before that, he was vice president of finance and chief financial officer for Universal Foods Corp, it said.
Hibner replaces Keith Monda, who has been senior vice president of finance and administration and chief financial officer for Timberland since 1993, it said.

Monda has been named to the new position of senior vice president of operations where his functions will include overseeing the company's manufacturing, sourcing, logistics, distribution and customer service operations.
